news.headline: DA Davidson Upgrades Broadcom to Buy, Raises Price Target to $400
Broadcom Expands Host Bus Adapter Support for Seagate SMR Technology
news.summary: Broadcom has added support for Seagate's Shingled Magnetic Recording (SMR) technology to its host bus adapter (HBA) product line to improve storage efficiency.

news.headline: Financial Institutions Form $63 Billion Financing Vehicle for Broadcom AI Infrastructure
news.summary: A coalition of banks and Blackstone is establishing a $63 billion special purpose vehicle to purchase Broadcom AI accelerators and networking solutions for lease to Anthropic.
